targetAudience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on
coreInsight: A quiet weekly check-in on gratitude, prayer, speech, kindness and intentions.
selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

script.onScreen: WEEKLY SELF-CHECK / Gratitude: did I thank Allah and people? · Prayer: which salah needs more care? · Speech: did my words help or hurt? · Kindness: who did I make smile? · Intention: what did I do for Allah?

caption:
Take one quiet minute to check in with yourself.

Gratitude · prayer · speech · kindness · intentions.

Reply with the one you'll work on.

#IslamicReminder #DailyDeen #SelfReflection

primaryCta.text: Reply: which one will you work on?

sourcesNote: Quotes pulled verbatim from the pinned datasets in sources/sources.json; everything else is our own reflection.

claims.text: The check-in questions are our own prompts.

items: Open every source link (quran.com / sunnah.com) and confirm the quote, reference and translation match what is on screen.
Read our own words (hook, reflection, caption) once more: nothing is attributed to Allah or the Prophet ﷺ that is not in the quoted source, and nothing reads as a ruling.
Watch the full MP4 at normal speed on a phone (pacing, readability, transitions) and listen to the recitation: it starts cleanly and is never cut.
Read the caption once more in Instagram's composer before posting.
